'Recovery management and no prehab': Strength and conditioning expert shares reason behind injuries in Indian cricket
results.description: In the recent times, it has been observed that players are suffering from injuries more often despite the fitness being focused open more than ever. The BCCI is also planning to bring more fitness standards to ensure the players remain injury free but the question remains - what is causing the injuries?

results.title: Supreme Court Rejects PIL Seeking Mandatory Biometric Attendance for School Students Across India
results.description: The Supreme Court of India on Friday refused to entertain a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) seeking directions to the Centre and state governments to implement a mandatory biometric-based attendance system for school students across the country.
